promptHead: Athlete goal: marathon (Wexley Lakes Marathon) on Sun Nov 1 2026, 10 weeks out, target under 3:45.

new.headline: Address knee pain by moderating the Wednesday workout while keeping volume and recovery on track.

flags.title: Knee pain
flags.detail: Monitor soreness after each run, especially the long run. Tempo: Keep the hard work brief and watch for pain recurrence.

flags.title: Heart rate
flags.detail: Long run HR dropped; maintain a comfortable zone 1‑2 pace.

flags.title: Recovery
flags.detail: Include low‑intensity easy runs to aid recovery.

answers.question: Is this an IT band thing? Should I still do Wednesday's tempo?
answers.answer: Is it likely IT‑band? It could be an over‑use irritation or a mild strain around the knee. If the pain is mild and not worsening, keep the Wednesday tempo but shorten the hard part to 2–3 mi at marathon pace, or replace it with a slightly harder easy run if any ache remains.

new.analysis:
The athlete’s knee tightness began during the 8‑mile long run and persisted after the week. The pain is on the outside of the right knee, a common area for IT‑band friction, but it could also be a mild strain from over‑use. Since there is no swelling or other red‑flag symptom, it is unlikely to be a serious injury. The recommendation is to keep the Wednesday session but reduce the hard component: run 6 mi total with 2 mi at marathon pace, or if pain is still evident, replace the tempo with a slightly harder easy run. Rest days are intact, and the rest of the week is arranged to keep about 80 % of time in low zones. The long run stays at 13.5 mi, easy pace, HR under 150. Recovery runs on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday are kept very easy. This plan keeps the build momentum while protecting the knee.

The flag section lists the knee pain, the tempo decision, heart‑rate focus, and recovery emphasis to help the athlete monitor progress. No safety callout is needed because pain is mild and no urgent medical issue was reported. The plan lines are concise, one sentence per day, and include why each session is chosen.
